To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the media are an important factor in the process of integration of foreigners into the host society and that the media can also be a factor of exclusion.

the media, and television in particular, have an important role for intercultural communication and that this role can be made more effective by a closer cooperation between media and ethnic minority organizations.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the analysis of the role of the media in the process of intercultural conflict, and with the question whether and how they contribute to a peaceful co-existence of different cultures and ethnic minorities.
the question of how media can be used as instruments for intercultural communication and as a tool for the promotion of intercultural understanding.
a) the analysis of the media's role as a cultural mediator and b) the analysis of media as a cultural producer.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
intercultural media research is a field of interdisciplinary and transdisciplinary research.
media studies and intercultural studies should not be separated from each other but should be integrated in the sense of an interdisciplinary approach to the analysis of the media.
media are a crucial factor in the construction and maintenance of cultural and ethnic identities and in the process of intercultural understanding.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

intercultural media research is a new and important field in the study of media, which is not only relevant for media research, but also for cultural studies and the analysis of social conflicts and their solutions in the context of globalisation and the new media.

intercultural media research is an interdisciplinary field of research which is concerned with the analysis of the intercultural aspects of communication processes in the media and with the study of the media in the context of intercultural relationships.
intercultural media analysis is not only a matter of intercultural competence but also a question of intercultural responsibility.
The main takeaway from our work is that
media are not only a mirror of society and a source of information, but also a tool for the shaping and transformation of culture.
media studies should be more sensitive to the intercultural aspects of media production and consumption and should not only focus on the analysis of the media text itself.
intercultural studies can only be carried out successfully if the media are taken into account as well.
